newsitem.title: USA: Musicland to close 5 Media Play stores.
newsitem.headline: Musicland to close 5 Media Play stores.

text.p: Musicland Stores Corp said on Tuesday it will close five Media Play stores in the Minneapolis-St. Paul area in January 1997, after closing 11 stores this year.
But the Media Play concept of large-format stores that offer compact discs, cassettes, computer software, video games and video movies, is not being discontinued, it added.
"Media Play will be a concept come January. It will just have a few less stores," said Marcia Appel, senior vice president of the company.
